_comment: Eval fixture (server/evals/checks): a text lesson in the shape of demo/cache/lessons/text-43e26ca1d86c37ed.json, continuing the calculator as a multi-file project (operations.py, main.py, test_operations.py). Only the steps the cases use.

steps.title: Import add into main.py
steps.action: In main.py, import add from operations and print add(2, 3)
steps.instructions: At the top of main.py, type the import line, then the print line below it.

targets.caption: Import add at the top of main.py

hints: The module name is the file name without .py.
The import goes at the very top of main.py.
common_mistakes: Putting the import in test_operations.py instead of main.py.

steps.title: Rename add to add_numbers
steps.action: Rename add to add_numbers with F2 (Rename Symbol) so every file follows
steps.instructions: Put the cursor on add in operations.py, press F2, type add_numbers and press Enter. VS Code updates main.py and the test too.
steps.code:
def add_numbers(a, b):
    return a + b
hints: F2 renames a symbol in every file that uses it; Find and Replace only changes the open file.
common_mistakes: Renaming the def by hand and forgetting the import line in main.py (ImportError).

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.what: pytest runs test_operations.py and every test passes
steps.action: Run python3 -m pytest -q in the VS Code terminal
steps.instructions: In the terminal, run python3 -m pytest -q and check that every test passes.
hints: Run it from the project folder, where test_operations.py is.
common_mistakes: Running pytest from the parent folder: no tests ran.
